forcing: CMFD daily 0.25° (direct NetCDF, not via VIC)

validation_against_literature.n2o: 7.3 kgN/ha/yr — slightly above Sichuan field range (1.9-6.7) and Bengbu validated (4.9); N2O EF=2.2% vs IPCC 1-2%. Higher N2O is consistent with higher fertilizer rate and longer simulation with soil C buildup.
validation_against_literature.co2_Rh: 4732 kgC/ha/yr — above typical arable literature (1000-2500) but plausible given high crop residue return (remains=0.65) and soil C accumulation phase (+386 kgC/ha/yr). Bengbu validated was 1537 for a shorter period.
validation_against_literature.ch4: 0.75 kgC/ha/yr — low, expected for upland (non-paddy) cropland
validation_against_literature.no3_leach: 6.1 kgN/ha/yr — below NCP range (38-60), consistent with loam soil retaining N
validation_against_literature.crop_yield: Wheat ~2400 kgC/ha, Maize ~1900 kgC/ha — reasonable for Huai River basin

issues: CO2 Rh higher than expected (4732 vs literature 1000-2500 kgC/ha/yr) — may be spinup artifact or residue-driven
N2O slightly above validated Bengbu range — possibly due to CMFD daily forcing (less diurnal variability than VIC 3-hourly)
tmin/tmax estimated as tavg±3°C from daily CMFD mean — ideally would use sub-daily extremes
